label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from Request Header 'Referer' flows directly to HTML output without sanitization. URLDecoder.decode() only handles URL encoding, not XSS prevention. Input reaches response.getWriter().println() which renders content as HTML, enabling reflected XSS attacks.

evidence.note: Untrusted user input retrieved from request.getHeader("Referer")
Input undergoes URL decoding which does not sanitize HTML/script content
Parameter flows through list operations and is returned without any HTML encoding before being written to response
Sink: Directly writes unsanitized parameter to HTML response via PrintWriter
